visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a scenic long shot of Mount Fuji, its snow-capped peak standing prominently against a clear blue sky. Bare tree branches frame the top of the screen. High-contrast white and red text overlays appear in the lower half of the frame. (2) A sharp cut to a medium close-up shows a payment terminal in Japan. A hand enters from the bottom, inserting a purple credit card into the slot. The lighting is bright indoor lighting, typical of a retail setting. (3) The scene shifts to a Taiwan High Speed Rail (THSR) train arriving at a platform. The orange and white nose of the train dominates the medium shot. (4) A woman with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a beige hat and a yellow sweater with a brown shoulder bag, is seen from a side view browsing a cosmetics shelf in a well-lit retail store. (5) Fast cuts follow, showing the interior of a shopping mall with clothing displays, an empty train carriage with green seats, and a close-up of a person's hands holding a Chiikawa-branded peach iced tea box. (6) A POV shot from an airplane window reveals white clouds and a large jet engine. This is followed by a top-down shot of an airplane meal tray featuring rice, vegetables, and tea. (7) The camera captures a person folding white bedding in a store, followed by more close-ups of a credit card being used at various terminals, including a self-checkout where a container of strawberries is being scanned. (8) A series of quick cuts displays store shelves filled with character merchandise like Snoopy and Chiikawa. A subway train is seen arriving at a city station. (9) A night shot shows Taipei 101 illuminated against a dark blue sky. (10) The main character, the woman seen earlier, stands in a brightly lit indoor space, holding the purple credit card up to the camera while smiling warmly. The video ends on a pink graphic background with brand social media icons.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, upbeat electronic pop BGM featuring a driving four-on-the-floor kick drum and bright, pulsating synthesizer melodies. No human vocals are present. The music sets a fast-paced, optimistic tone. (2) At roughly two seconds, a bright "ding" digital SFX coincides with the card insertion visual. The BGM continues uninterrupted, maintaining its steady tempo of approximately 128 BPM. (3) As scenes transition rapidly between different locations, subtle UI-style "whoosh" or "pop" sound effects punctuate the visual cuts, adding a sense of digital interaction. The acoustic texture remains very clean with no audible ambient floor noise. (4) The middle section of the audio track continues the looping pop melody with consistent brightness and high arousal. The percussive elements are prominent, emphasizing the fast editing rhythm of the video. (5) Toward the end, the BGM maintains its intensity without any harmonic buildup or tension shift, concluding with a sharp cut-off as the final brand logo appears, accompanied by a final digital jingle SFX.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features a clear display of the bank's credit card, mentions specific cashback percentages, and includes a call to action to use a specific application link.
